title: 首席点破：剧烈波动才需担忧，10年期是关键指标
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: And does, you know, if rates stay higher for longer, does this derail this equity rally in any way? Looking in a shock environment, as we all know, correlations tend to tick closer to one than not.
segments.zh: 如果利率长期维持高位，这是否会阻碍股市反弹？在冲击环境下，众所周知，相关性往往趋近于1。

segments.en: And right now, it's certainly the case that we're getting a lot of, perhaps, panic repricing around that. Gold, I think, is a good example.
segments.zh: 目前，我们确实看到很多恐慌性重新定价。黄金就是一个很好的例子。

segments.en: There's a lot of talk about AI crowding out long duration demand. I haven't seen that in the swap spreads. I've seen it moderately in corporate spreads, but actually swap spreads have been reasonably well-behaved, so I don't necessarily buy that argument.
segments.zh: 有很多关于AI挤出长久期需求的讨论。我在互换利差中没有看到这一点。在公司利差中略有体现，但互换利差表现良好，所以我不太相信这个论点。

segments.en: And again, I think this is certainly a real rate story, but importantly, it's a velocity story around real rates. If we see a gradual move in real rates, I don't think it spooks the market.
segments.zh: 再说一次，这确实是实际利率的故事，但重要的是，这是实际利率变化速度的故事。如果我们看到实际利率逐步变动，我认为不会吓到市场。

segments.en: If we start to see pronounced dramatic moves, and yes, absolutely, I would be a lot more concerned about that. But I'm not seeing that right now.
segments.zh: 如果我们开始看到显著剧烈的变动，那么我绝对会更加担忧。但目前我没有看到这种情况。

segments.en: Typically, if you see, for example, the 10-year moving aggressively from its trough, 7500 basis points, then get worried. But right now, we're not seeing that.
segments.zh: 通常，例如，如果10年期收益率从低点大幅上行75个基点，那么需要担心。但目前我们没有看到这种情况。

segments.en: And so actually, I think the equity story, particularly as it broadens and deepens, away from that sort of AI thematic, becomes a lot more sustainable.
segments.zh: 因此，实际上，我认为股市行情，特别是当它从AI主题中拓宽和深化时，会变得更加可持续。
